processNotes: Historical routing records final assembly at work center 60 for product 771. Preparation at work center 50 and the detailed sequence at both centers are inferred, not engineering specifications.
Manufactured subassemblies are presented as complete for this demonstration. The representative frame BOM includes one fork; no separate fork is added to the bike BOM.
Each direct component is listed as 1 EA in the representative BOM. The pedal entry is preserved as 1 EA without assuming whether it represents a pair.
variantNotes: The representative Silver, 38 uses frame 748, FR-M94S-38. Silver, 42 uses frame 739, FR-M94S-42; Silver, 44 uses frame 740, FR-M94S-44; Silver, 48 uses frame 741, named Silver, 48 but numbered FR-M94S-52 in the snapshot. Verify that discrepancy before selecting the frame.
Black, 38 uses frame 747, FR-M94B-38; Black, 42 uses frame 743, FR-M94B-42; Black, 44 uses frame 744, FR-M94B-44; Black, 48 uses frame 745, FR-M94B-48.

All eight variant BOMs list the same other 13 direct components, including front wheel 817 and rear wheel 825, each at 1 EA. Do not substitute the representative silver frame for a different color or size.
The representative frame BOM specifies 8 OZ of silver paint. Paint BOMs for the other variant frames are not supplied, so their paint selections are not inferred.

revisions.description: Initial controlled issue for product introduction; established the component list and work-center sequence.

Released the illustrated workstation edition: Frame, steering and wheel assembly; Drivetrain placement. Matched numbered component legends to the operating steps and adopted the Manufacturing Hub document layout.

100191.title: Frame, steering and wheel assembly
guidance: Support 1 EA of HL Mountain Frame - Silver, 38 (Product Number FR-M94S-38) in an assumed bicycle assembly stand. Position its included fork for the steering assembly.
Fit 1 EA of HL Headset (Product Number HS-3479) at the frame and fork steering interface, then fit 1 EA of HL Mountain Handlebars (Product Number HB-M918).
Fit 1 EA of HL Mountain Seat Assembly (Product Number SA-M687) to the frame and check its alignment.
Fit 1 EA of HL Mountain Front Wheel (Product Number FW-M928) at the front fork and 1 EA of HL Mountain Rear Wheel (Product Number RW-M928) at the rear frame. Check that both rotate freely.

100192.title: Drivetrain placement
guidance: Fit 1 EA of HL Bottom Bracket (Product Number BB-9108) to the frame, followed by 1 EA of HL Crankset (Product Number CS-9183) and 1 EA of HL Mountain Pedal (Product Number PD-M562).

Fit 1 EA of Front Derailleur (Product Number FD-2342) and 1 EA of Rear Derailleur (Product Number RD-2308), then route 1 EA of Chain (Product Number CH-0234) through the drivetrain. Check movement by hand.
